sentences.text: This is a First Appeal challenging the judgment and award dated 11th October, 2022 passed by M.A.C.T., Pune in M.A.C.P. No. 613 of 2017.

2. Mr. Kanojia, learned counsel for the appellant would submit that this is not a case of negligence of the driver of the vehicle that was insured by the policy company but a case of the tyre burst due to which the car caught fire and the deceased who was occupant, KVM 26 - FA 641 OF 2023.doc died due to severe injuries although the driver of the car was booked vide C.R. No. 12/2017.

3. Mr.Kanojia would further submit that therefore the claim filed under section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 ought to have been dismissed as the claim was not made under section 163A where the compensation can be claimed only on the ground of involvement of the vehicle in the accident and it is not necessary to prove the negligence.

5. Having heard learned counsel and having perused the impugned decision and the grounds, issue notice to the respondents in First Appeal as well as in the Interim Application No. 12870 of 2023 returnable on 18th August, 2023.

In the meanwhile, let there be a stay on the execution of the judgment and award dated 11th October, 2022 in M.A.C.P. No. 613 of 2017 subject to deposit of the entire decreetal amount in M.A.C.T., Pune within a period of four weeks.
